description:
Dataverse Record Recovery brings back Dynamics 365 / Dataverse records that were deleted by mistake, using the audit history of the environment. Records come back with their original GUID, so links, integrations and URLs that point to them keep working.

Pick a table, optionally the user who deleted the records and a date range, then search the audit history. Every deleted record found is listed with its name, GUID, deletion date and author; click one to see the column values it had before its deletion.

Before anything is written, a preview shows the full recovery plan: the selected records, the related records deleted with them in cascade, and the missing parent records they reference, created parents first. Records that already exist are left out. You can uncheck any record, compare previous and restored values column by column, and read every warning.

The recovery also puts back the status of each record (cases and opportunities are closed with their dedicated messages), its N:N associations, and the lookups of records that were not deleted but were unlinked by the deletion. Options let you keep the original Created On date and skip custom plug-ins and flows during the restore. A recovery log gives the result of each record.

Requires auditing to be enabled on the tables when the records were deleted, and the View Audit History / View Audit Summary privileges. English and French interface.
releaseNotes:
1.0.2 - Package update

- Plugin assembly renamed DataverseRecordRecovery.dll (no spaces), as expected by the XrmToolBox Tool Library.
- No functional change.

1.0.1 - Package update

- Tool icon embedded in the package, so it shows in the XrmToolBox Tool Library.
- No functional change.

1.0.0 - First release

- Search deleted records in the audit history by table, user who deleted them and date range (local time), with a maximum number of records.
- Option to list only the tables whose auditing is on; warning when auditing is disabled in the environment.
- Values before deletion shown for each deleted record; records that exist again are hidden.
- Records restored with their original GUID, original owner when possible, and optionally their original Created On date.
- Related records deleted in cascade found around each deletion (configurable time window) and missing parent records restored first.
- Status restored after creation; cases and opportunities closed with their dedicated messages.
- N:N associations rebuilt from the audit history and unlinked records linked back.
- Review dialog with the recovery tree, previous / restored values per column, warnings and an explicit approval before any write.
- Optional bypass of custom plug-ins and flows during the restore.
- Recovery log with the result of each record, and an option to open the restored records in the browser.
- Clear messages for missing privileges, English and French interface, settings remembered between sessions.
summary: Restore deleted Dynamics 365 / Dataverse records from the audit history with their original GUID, together with their related records, N:N associations and status, after a full preview.
title: Dataverse Record Recovery
